# hypothesis: Any passes through a call unchanged and is accepted where int is expected, while an object-typed value keeps type object and is rejected where int is expected.
from typing import Any, assert_type, reveal_type


def first(items: list[Any]) -> Any:
    return items[0]


def add_one(n: int) -> int:
    return n + 1


def keep(v: object) -> object:
    return v


def try_add(v: object) -> int:
    return add_one(v)  # expect-error


raw: list[Any] = [4, 5]
got = first(raw)
reveal_type(got)
assert_type(got, Any)
print(add_one(got))

boxed = keep(4)
reveal_type(boxed)
assert_type(boxed, object)
print(str(boxed))
print(try_add(4))
hypothesis: Any passes through a call unchanged and is accepted where int is expected, while an object-typed value keeps type object and is rejected where int is expected.
